company.name: Courier
company.shortDescription: Courier is a notification-creation program for app developers that offers push notifications, emails, chat, slack, and custom channels.
company.description: Courier offers an API that lets developers intelligently route user notifications across their existing channels – like SendGrid, Twilio, Slack, and Facebook Messenger – using factors like "is the user online?" and "which channel has produced the most engagement for this user previously?"
